column1: customer|Someone who buys goods or services.|Each customer receives a receipt after payment.
shop|A place where goods are sold.|The shop closes early on public holidays.
supermarket|A large shop selling food and household goods.|The supermarket offers a home-delivery service.
market|A place where different sellers offer goods.|The weekend market sells fresh local produce.
checkout|The place where customers pay for goods.|Please take your basket to the nearest checkout.
counter|A surface where customers are served.|Collect your order from the service counter.
aisle|A passage between shelves or rows.|Cleaning products are in the final aisle.
basket|A container used to carry items while shopping.|Return your basket after paying.
trolley|A wheeled container for carrying shopping.|Please do not leave your trolley in the car park.
stock|Goods available for sale or use.|The blue jacket is currently out of stock.
product|An item made or offered for sale.|Read the safety label before using the product.
item|One particular thing in a group.|One item was missing from my delivery.
brand|The name identifying a company's products.|This brand offers a two-year guarantee.
model|A particular version of a product.|The newer model uses less electricity.
size|The dimensions or usual measurement of something.|Please check the size before removing the label.
colour|The visual quality described as red, blue and other shades.|The replacement should be the same colour as the original.
quality|How good or suitable something is.|The material is of better quality than I expected.
quantity|The amount or number of something.|Please confirm the quantity before placing the order.
price|The amount charged for something.|The displayed price includes tax.
cost|The money needed to obtain or do something.|The total cost includes installation.
charge|Money requested for a particular service.|There is an extra charge for weekend delivery.
fee|An amount paid for a service or membership.|The booking fee is not refundable.
discount|A reduction in the usual price.|Show your student card to receive a discount.
sale|A period when goods are offered at reduced prices.|The winter sale begins on Saturday.
offer|A special arrangement or reduced price.|This offer is available until the end of the month.
promotion code|Letters or numbers entered to receive a special offer.|Enter the promotion code before making payment.
voucher|A document or code exchangeable for goods or a discount.|The voucher can be used at any branch.
coupon|A ticket giving a discount on a particular purchase.|The coupon expires at the end of this week.
bargain|Something bought for less than its usual value.|The second-hand desk was a bargain.
receipt|A document confirming that payment has been made.|Keep your receipt if you might return the item.
refund|Money returned to a customer.|I would like a refund for the cancelled delivery.
exchange|Replacing a purchased item with another one.|The shop allows an exchange within fourteen days.
return|To take or send a purchased item back.|You can return the unopened package by post.
replacement|An item supplied instead of a missing or faulty one.|The replacement arrived without an additional charge.
guarantee|A formal promise about quality or service.|The written guarantee explains your options if the repair fails.
faulty|Not working correctly.|Please stop using the faulty charger.
damaged|Physically harmed or broken.|The parcel arrived with a damaged corner.
missing|Not present where it should be.|Please send the missing instruction booklet.
unwanted|No longer needed or desired.|Unwanted gifts can be exchanged with a valid receipt.
unused|Not previously used.|The store accepts returns of unused footwear.
second-hand|Previously owned or used by someone else.|The community shop sells second-hand furniture.
expired|No longer valid or safe after a stated date.|The cashier could not accept the expired voucher.
valid|Accepted or usable under the relevant rules.|The discount is valid only on weekdays.
expiry date|The last date on which something may be used.|Check the expiry date before using the coupon.
refundable|Eligible to be paid back under stated conditions.|The delivery deposit is refundable when the crate is returned.
complaint|A statement that a product or service is unsatisfactory.|Please send your complaint to the customer-care team.
customer service|Help provided to customers before or after a purchase.|Customer service can track your missing order.
enquiry|A request for information.|I am writing with an enquiry about the repair service.
order|A request to supply particular goods or services.|Your order will be ready for collection tomorrow.
booking|An arrangement to receive a service at a particular time.|Please confirm your booking by email.
reservation|An arrangement to keep a place or item for someone.|The restaurant will hold your reservation for fifteen minutes.
cancellation|The ending of a planned booking or arrangement.|Late cancellation may result in an additional fee.
delivery|Taking goods to the person who ordered them.|Delivery is free for orders above fifty dollars.
collection|Picking up something that has been prepared or left for you.|Your parcel is ready for collection at the depot.
parcel|An item wrapped for delivery.|Sign for the parcel when it arrives.
package|A wrapped item or group of items.|Please keep the package until you have checked the contents.
packaging|The materials used to protect or contain goods.|The packaging can be placed in the recycling bin.
tracking|Following the progress or location of a delivery.|Use the tracking number to check delivery progress.
postage|The cost of sending something by post.|Return postage is covered if the item is faulty.
shipping|The process or cost of transporting goods.|International shipping may take two weeks.
instructions|Information explaining how to use or do something.|Follow the instructions before connecting the appliance.
manual|A guide explaining how to use equipment.|Keep the manual for future reference.
label|A small piece of information attached to an item.|The label explains how to wash the jacket.
barcode|A pattern scanned to identify an item.|The cashier scanned the barcode on the box.
comparison|Looking at similarities and differences between options.|A price comparison helped us choose a supplier.
affordable range|A selection of products priced within a limited budget.|The store has an affordable range of kitchen equipment.
available|Ready to be obtained or used.|The replacement filter is available at the service desk.
unavailable|Not currently obtainable or usable.|The online booking service is unavailable this evening.
limited|Restricted in amount or availability.|There is a limited supply of discounted tickets.
accessory|An additional item used with a main product.|The carrying case is sold as an accessory.
spare part|A component used to replace a broken one.|The technician has ordered the necessary spare part.
repair service|A service that fixes damaged goods or equipment.|The repair service can collect large appliances from your home.
appointment|An arrangement to meet or receive a service at a set time.|Book an appointment before bringing the device in.
queue|A line of people waiting for service.|Please join the queue beside the information desk.
waiting list|A list of people waiting for a place or service.|Your name has been added to the waiting list.
loyalty card|A card used to collect rewards for regular purchases.|Show your loyalty card before paying.
membership|The status of belonging to a group or service.|Annual membership includes discounted equipment hire.
trial|A limited period used to test a service or product.|The free trial ends after seven days.
recommendation|Advice suggesting a suitable choice.|The assistant gave me a recommendation for an energy-saving model.
purchase|To buy something.|You can purchase replacement filters online.
consumer|Someone who uses goods or services.|The leaflet explains consumer rights when goods are faulty.
retailer|A business that sells goods directly to customers.|Contact the retailer if your order has not arrived.
supplier|A business that provides goods or materials.|The supplier will deliver the replacement parts tomorrow.
manufacturer|A company that makes products.|The manufacturer recommends cleaning the filter monthly.
warranty|A promise to repair or replace a product under stated conditions.|The warranty covers faults but not accidental damage.
defective|Having a fault that makes something unsuitable for use.|The company has recalled the defective product.
refurbished|Repaired and prepared for use again.|The refurbished laptop comes with a limited warranty.
terms and conditions|The rules that apply to an agreement or offer.|Please read the terms and conditions before subscribing.
non-refundable|Not eligible for repayment after purchase or cancellation.|The special ticket is non-refundable.
subscription|An arrangement for regular access or deliveries in return for payment.|You can cancel your monthly subscription online.
dispatch|Sending goods to their destination.|You will receive an email after dispatch.
shipment|A quantity of goods sent together.|The shipment has been delayed by bad weather.
courier|A person or company that delivers parcels.|The courier left a card because nobody was home.
installation|The process of putting equipment in place ready for use.|The price includes installation of the washing machine.
assembly|Putting separate parts together to form a complete item.|The desk requires assembly after delivery.
exclusive|Available only to a particular group or source.|Members receive exclusive discounts on repairs.
inclusive|Including the stated costs or services.|The inclusive price covers delivery and assembly.
optional extra|An additional item or service that can be chosen.|Express delivery is an optional extra.
demonstration|Showing how something works or is used.|Ask for a demonstration before buying the machine.
after-sales support|Help provided after a customer has bought something.|The retailer offers after-sales support by phone.
